sql: WITH administrators AS (SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District FROM schools UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName2, District FROM schools UNION ALL SELECT AdmFName3, District FROM schools) SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS administrator_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT District) AS districts FROM administrators WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(first_name) <> '' GROUP BY first_name ORDER BY administrator_count DESC, first_name LIMIT 2;
